posts.text: What is FISA? Speaker of the House Mike Johnson called democratic and Republican lawmakers who voted against extending FISA “shameful”.  To understand how wrong Johnson is, let’s look at what FISA - a law that allows warrantless surveillance - is and how the U.S. government uses it.

posts.text: Does Los Angeles County have a 112% registration rate? The question was asked because a lawsuit alleged that. But the truth is that Los Angeles County keeps active and inactive voters (who can’t vote) in  its voter rolls. This makes the total number of  registrations contained in the rolls larger than the voting population, but only because inactive voters may have passed or moved out of the county.  Let’s fact check @Truly Salty
